To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

estrogenic ligands down-regulate Cyp2c19 expression via estrogen receptors α and β, which bind to a newly identified estrogen response element (ERE) half site at the position −152/−147 in its promoter.
estrogen receptor α, a nuclear hormone receptor, binds to a previously unidentified estrogen response element in the promoter of CYP2D6 and thereby inhibits its expression.
estradiol and ethinylestradiols inhibit CYP2B19 expression via estrogen receptors, which interact with a newly identified estrogen response element in the CYPB19 promoter.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the regulatory mechanism underlying the inhibition of the CYP2D6 enzyme by female sex steroids.
the regulation of CYP2 C19 expression and the possible consequences for the pharmacokinetics of drugs.
the regulation of CYP2 C19 expression and its potential inhibition by female sex steroids.

the estrogenic effect of oral contracep-tives inhibits CYP2C9 expression, whereas the competitive inhibition of CYP2Cs by these contraceptives is only observed at much higher concentrations.
oral contraceptives do not only inhibit CYP2D6 activity by a competitive mechanism but also inhibit CYP2B6 and CYP2C9 activity via an ER-dependent transcriptional mechanism.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CYP gene family is a novel and important target for the estrogen signaling pathway, which may be involved in drug metabolism.
estrogenic steroids can inhibit CYP2D6 and CYP2C9 expression via ERβ and CYP2B6 expression via both ERα and ERβ, whereas CYP2C11 and CYP2D9 are regulated by both ERα and glucocorticoid receptor.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the CYP450 enzyme CYP2C9 is downregulated by the estrogen receptor.
oral contraceptives can inhibit CYP2c19 expression by binding to estrogen receptor α.
oral contraceptives can affect drug metabolism not only by competitive inhibition of CYP2D6 but also by down-regulating CYP2C9 and CYP2C18 expression.
